prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Ninetales (나인테일) personified, fire type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut and skin tone; her figure follows BODY TYPE; expression and hair motion may change.

FACE: exactly the face of the attached image — the same face shape, jawline, eye shape and size, nose, lips and their proportions, and the same skin rendering. From any camera angle or pose — low or high camera, chin resting on a hand, profile, looking back — keep the reference image’s face shape, jaw length and face length-to-width ratio; perspective and pose must never lengthen her lower face or make her jaw look heavier than in the reference. Do not add skin texture, pores, harder nose or lip modelling, a face lengthened by the camera angle, a heavy jaw, or any facial definition the attached image does not have.

BODY TYPE: an hourglass figure with a subtly full bust, a slim waist and very wide, curvy rounded hips that flow smoothly into softly full thighs, the line tapering gradually toward the knees with no sudden narrowing below the hips, and slender lower legs — never thick or heavy — it reads clearly through the outfit. The attached image's armor hides her figure, so take her body shape from this line, not from the armor's outline; her head stays in natural adult proportion to her body.

STYLE: High-detail Japanese anime-style 2.5D character illustration. A refined adult anime face with large expressive eyes, delicately drawn eyelids, a small simplified nose and mouth, and a compact tapered jaw. Fine subtle linework, smooth skin shading and softly blended gradients. Layered flowing hair with carefully drawn strands and delicate highlights. Highly detailed clothing and accessories with convincing fabric weave, stitching, folds, seams, buckles and material-specific reflections. Combine stylized anime facial features with richly rendered dimensional clothing. Use luminous midtones, restrained highlights on clothing, and a delicate pastel palette. Her skin has a glossy sheen — smooth, bright specular highlights on her shoulders, collarbones, chest, arms and thighs, a polished lustrous finish over her skin tone, never wet or oily. Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her species shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never armor, never a creature costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

WORLD: this scene happens inside the Pokémon world, as if she simply lives there — its towns, routes, buildings, props, light and weather show the world. No Pokémon unless SCENE names her companion, no known trainers or characters, no logos, no text.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: a camouflaged field hide at the edge of a meadow, a tripod set inside
Outfit: An original soft sage-green sweater with a folded overlapping collar over an opaque inner panel, diagonal seed-stitch panels and relaxed full-length cotton trousers with curved front seams and turn-up hems, worn with practical flat shoes.
Cut: plunging neckline and off-shoulder neckline built into the outfit — a figure-hugging fit that follows her curves; chest and pelvis stay securely covered.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; head turned back over her own left shoulder — the shoulder on the image's left side; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — on the image's right side, since her back is to the camera.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side — on the image's left side, since her back is to the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a Poké Ball at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: paused mid-walk, weight on the front foot.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: an unposed in-between expression, mouth caught mid-shape, brows natural. Show it mildly, only with her brows, eyelids and mouth corners; her face shape and features stay exactly as in the attached image.
Scene note: Late-summer morning light falls across the meadow beyond the hide.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: low — mostly covered clothing, limited neck/hand exposure unless outfit is explicit
action_level: mostly active — an active mid-action moment compatible with the selected pose
source_influence: strong — her species is clearly recognizable through a few accessories and props in the scene, never through the outfit's colours, patterns or cut; no new armor or creature anatomy
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face and hair — not its armor, garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her source belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

LOOK-BACK: her back is toward the camera and her head turns at most a quarter turn over one shoulder — the face shows in profile or three-quarter view, never full-front on a back-facing torso. Her chin sits just above the near shoulder, the far eye and cheek may be partly hidden, the side of the neck shows the turn and the shoulder line continues behind the head. Where her eyes go follows GAZE.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions — about 7.5 heads tall, her head in proportion to her shoulders and body. No extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.
